post.description:
Compute the geometric matrix bundle for a coil (runs the FEM solve).

The slow call (~seconds). Cache the returned bundle on the client and
pass it back to the fast endpoints to avoid recomputing while adjusting
non-geometry parameters.
Full JavaTC-style analysis plus the coupled solve (splitting).

Primary driving-point impedance sweep with the secondary installed.

The complex impedance looking into the primary tank terminals at each
requested frequency - the coupled-system feature that shows the split
resonances as peaks. Requires a primary tank capacitance.

Export the coupled system as a SPICE subcircuit.

A network reproducing the coupled model's AC/transient behavior, for
dropping the coil into a larger SPICE schematic. Requires a primary
tank capacitance.

Operating electric or magnetic field on a regular (r, z) grid.

Superposes precomputed basis fields (cached by geometry) with the phasor
drive at the requested frequency and primary current, so re-rendering a
new drive is fast. Requires a primary with a tank capacitance.

get.description: Root endpoint providing basic API information.

modes.description: Voltage and current eigenmode shapes of the secondary

bundle.description: The matrix bundle used (echo it back to reuse)

AnalysisResponse.title: AnalysisResponse
AnalysisResponse.description:
Full JavaTC-style analysis. primary/coupling are null for a coil
with no primary; coupled is null without a primary tank capacitance.

AnalyzeRequest.title: AnalyzeRequest
AnalyzeRequest.description:
Request a full analysis, reusing a precomputed matrix bundle.

The bundle must match the coil's geometry (its geometry_fingerprint is
validated); a mismatch returns 409. Omit the bundle to have the server
compute it inline (equivalent to calling the matrices endpoint first,
but without returning the bundle to the client).

mid.title: Mid
mid.description: A point the arc passes through, between start and end

ArcPathSchema.title: ArcPathSchema
ArcPathSchema.description:
A circular-arc centerline: the unique arc from ``start`` to ``end``
passing through ``mid``.

Three points on the arc (in traversal order) determine everything with
no sign conventions: the circle, the bend direction, and whether the
minor or major arc is taken. The points must not be collinear (a
straight centerline is a line path).

bc_type.description: Dirichlet (fixed potential) or Neumann (zero normal field)

BoundaryConditionSchema.title: BoundaryConditionSchema
BoundaryConditionSchema.description: Boundary condition on a simulation-domain wall.

CircleSchema.title: CircleSchema
CircleSchema.description: A circular (r, z) cross section - a toroid when revolved off-axis.

CircularCrossSectionSchema.title: CircularCrossSectionSchema
CircularCrossSectionSchema.description: Round conductor of a given diameter.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the value was not computed (null when computed)

ComputedValue.title: ComputedValue
ComputedValue.description:
A derived output that is only valid under documented assumptions.

``value`` is null when the assumptions do not hold for this coil, with
``reason`` explaining why (chained through dependent values, e.g. "Q
could not be computed because it depends on Rac: ..."). The UI renders
null values as "Not computed" with the reason as a tooltip.

CoupledOutputs.title: CoupledOutputs
CoupledOutputs.description:
Full coupled primary-secondary solve. Present only when the primary
has a tank capacitance.

voltage_positions.title: Voltage Positions
voltage_positions.description: Arc length (m) along the winding for each voltage node

current_positions.title: Current Positions
current_positions.description: Arc length (m) along the winding for each current segment

EigenModesOutputs.title: EigenModesOutputs
EigenModesOutputs.description:
The secondary's transmission-line eigenmodes: for every eigenfrequency,
the voltage mode shape (nodal voltages along the winding) and the current
mode shape (segment currents).

Amplitudes are the raw eigenvector values (arbitrary overall scale), with
only the physically-arbitrary eigenvector SIGN fixed to a convention
(top-node voltage positive) so a mode does not flip between analyses.
Positions are arc length in meters along the winding centerline, measured
from the grounded base (0) to the top terminal (``winding_length``).

The voltage profile includes the grounded base node (value 0 at arc length
0), so ``voltage_positions`` has one more entry than ``current_positions``.

grounded_end.title: Grounded End
grounded_end.description: Which primary winding end is grounded/cold (E-field only); the opposite end carries V_p

FieldRequest.title: FieldRequest
FieldRequest.description:
Operating electric or magnetic field on a regular (r, z) grid.

Reuses a matrix bundle for the drive solve; the basis fields are cached
server-side by geometry, so changing the drive re-renders fast. Requires
a primary with a tank capacitance.

mask.title: Mask
mask.description: True where the field is defined

FieldResponse.title: FieldResponse
FieldResponse.description:
A complex field sampled on a regular grid, row-major (z outer, r
inner). The client reshapes ``real``/``imag`` to (nz, nr) and takes the
gradient/curl (using unit_scale for metres) for E or B.

GradedTurnProfileSchema.title: GradedTurnProfileSchema
GradedTurnProfileSchema.description:
Cumulative turn counts at control points along the winding.

Each point is (u, n): u the normalized position along the path (0 =
start, 1 = end) and n the cumulative turn count there. The first point
must be (0, 0), the last must have u = 1 (its n is the total turn
count), and both coordinates must be strictly increasing. Turns
interpolate linearly between points (constant pitch within each band).

include_losses.title: Include Losses
include_losses.description: Use AC/DC resistances so peaks are finite

include_tank.title: Include Tank
include_tank.description: Include the series tank capacitor (full LC input)

ImpedanceRequest.title: ImpedanceRequest
ImpedanceRequest.description:
Primary driving-point impedance sweep with the secondary installed.

Reuses a matrix bundle (fast). Requires a primary tank capacitance.

LinePathSchema.title: LinePathSchema
LinePathSchema.description: A straight centerline from start to end.

MatricesRequest.title: MatricesRequest
MatricesRequest.description: Request the geometric matrix bundle for a coil (the slow FEM path).

topload_charge.title: Topload Charge
topload_charge.description: Length-(N+1) geometric topload charge per tent solve

coupling.title: Coupling
coupling.description: Length-N geometric coupling vector (empty if no primary)

geometry_fingerprint.title: Geometry Fingerprint
geometry_fingerprint.description: Hash of the geometry the bundle was computed for

MatrixBundleSchema.title: MatrixBundleSchema
MatrixBundleSchema.description:
Geometry-only matrices (geometric units) plus their provenance.

Treat this as an opaque token on the client: obtain it from the
matrices endpoint, cache it, and send it back to the analyze endpoint.
The geometry_fingerprint guards against applying it to a coil whose
geometry has changed.

PolygonSchema.title: PolygonSchema
PolygonSchema.description: A general polygon defined by >= 3 vertices.

PrimarySchema.title: PrimarySchema
PrimarySchema.description: A primary wound along a parametric (r, z) centerline path.

vertices.title: Vertices
vertices.description: Four (r, z) vertices, in boundary order

RectangleSchema.title: RectangleSchema
RectangleSchema.description: A rectangular region defined by exactly 4 vertices.

SecondaryConductorSchema.title: SecondaryConductorSchema
SecondaryConductorSchema.description: A secondary wound along a parametric (r, z) centerline path.

unit_scale.title: Unit Scale
unit_scale.description: Meters per geometry unit (e.g. 0.0254 for inches)

SimulatableTeslaCoilSchema.title: SimulatableTeslaCoilSchema
SimulatableTeslaCoilSchema.description: A complete coil plus its simulation domain and boundary conditions.

SpiceRequest.title: SpiceRequest
SpiceRequest.description: Export the coupled system as a SPICE subcircuit. Reuses a bundle.

SplinePathSchema.title: SplinePathSchema
SplinePathSchema.description: An interpolating centripetal Catmull-Rom spline through the points.

UniformTurnProfileSchema.title: UniformTurnProfileSchema
UniformTurnProfileSchema.description:
Evenly wound: constant turn density along the winding path.

The profile's parameter domain is derived from the winding curve by the
model itself, so the schema carries no domain fields.
